title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: Proration of Late Fees by Days Late for Established Tenants
content:
**Rule.** For a tenant who has held the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement at least 36 months and made at least 10 payments on it in the last 12 months, the late fee is prorated by the days late over 30 days — the fee multiplied by the number of days late divided by 30 — and never by more than the whole fee. For a tenant who has held it at least 12 months but fewer than 36 months and made at least 6 payments on it in the last 12 months, it is prorated by the days late over 20 days in the same way, never by more than the whole fee. Every other tenant is charged the fee in full under this rule.

**Terms.**
- Months held: whole calendar months from the start date to the handling date, to the same day of the later month.
- Payments: payment entries on the agreement's ledger in the window. A window of the last 12 months covers ledger entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month.
- Days late: the calendar days from the date the agreement's lateness is counted from to the handling date, less the grace period days of the class.
- What is prorated: the late fee as it stands once kept within the class's late-fee ceiling and multiplied by anything it is multiplied by; the prorated amount is not rounded at this point, and the fee is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

### Worked cases (hypothetical; fee before proration $40.00)

| Tenant | Days late | Proportion | Fee after proration |
|---|---|---|---|
| 48 months held, 12 payments | 12 | 12 thirtieths | $16.00 |
| 48 months held, 12 payments | 45 | capped at the whole fee | $40.00 |
| 20 months held, 7 payments | 5 | 5 twentieths | $10.00 |
| 20 months held, 7 payments | 20 | the whole fee | $40.00 |
| 48 months held, 8 payments | any | not prorated | $40.00 |
| 9 months held | any | not prorated | $40.00 |

The case of 48 months with 8 payments is not prorated: the 30-day proration needs 10 payments, and the 20-day proration is limited to tenants under 36 months.
